title: Refund timeline
text: Approved refunds are usually returned to the original payment method within 5-7 business days. Bank processing can occasionally take longer.

title: Password reset
text: Customers can reset their password from Settings > Security > Reset password. A reset email expires after 30 minutes.

title: Shipping estimate
text: Standard shipping normally takes 3-5 business days after an order is dispatched.

title: Order cancellation
text: An order can be cancelled before it enters shipment processing. Once dispatched, the customer should request a return instead.

title: Human review policy
text: Escalate requests involving payment disputes, account security incidents, or uncertain answers that cannot be supported by the knowledge base.
